items.Sentence: The WWTF consists of multiple septic tanks and two oxidation-evaporation ponds (Ponds 1 and 2).
The WWTF consists of multiple septic tanks and two oxidation-evaporation ponds (Ponds 1 and 2). A spray system is used to aerate the wastewater within the ponds.
Wastewater from the Administrative Center and Recreation Area restrooms gravity flow to septic tanks and is then pumped to Pond 1.
Sludge and solids in the septic tanks are pumped out annually to an approved disposal facility.
